offering_description.value: Acquires and develops raw land into finished residential lots, then sells those lots to homebuilders across the United States. It also provides land development management for third parties and holds some mineral interests.

primary_products.value: finished residential lots; raw land parcels

primary_services.value: land development management for third parties

customer_segment.value: B2B: homebuilders, including its largest customer, D.R. Horton

end_markets.value: residential construction; homebuilding; real estate development

revenue_model.value: product sales: finished residential lots sold to homebuilders; service fees: fees for developing land for third-party owners; licensing or royalties: oil, gas and mineral royalties from held mineral interests
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and develops land parcels, taking in raw land and selling finished lots to homebuilders; service provider: manages land development projects for third-party landowners

geography_served.value: US national: Southeast, Southwest, Texas, Mid-Atlantic and other US regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: residential lot development is its single core business line

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: lot sale contracts negotiated directly with homebuilders

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: zoning, subdivision and environmental permitting for land development, under local governments and state environmental agencies
